purpose: Reusable data model for I Can See The Future role intelligence pages, workforce atlas views and board packs.

fields.role_family: delivery, product, change, data, cyber, executive, etc
fields.sfia_level: optional SFIA level or equivalent maturity marker
fields.human_value_retention: number percentage describing value likely to remain human-led
fields.task_coverage: array of task objects with task, ai_coverage_2030, ai_role, human_value
fields.timeline: object keyed by year with title and description
fields.individual_actions: array of recommended actions for workers
fields.employer_actions: array of recommended actions for organisations
fields.commercial_path: individual report, team atlas, enterprise workforce forecast, board pack

revenue_paths.enterprise: Future Workforce Atlas and Board Pack
